title: Sync Centre
purpose: Configure aggregate-only long-poll and WebSocket federation with encrypted tokens, explicit consent and live status.
noLabMessage: Federation identity is tied to a registered laboratory code.
noLabHelp: Select a laboratory whose code matches a registered central-server site.

connection.title: Server connection
connection.description: HTTPS base URL used for token configuration, long-poll requests and the derived WebSocket endpoint.
connection.verifyTlsDetail: Keep enabled for production. Disabling is intended only for explicitly controlled local development.
connection.autoTokenDetail: Request access polls securely in the background until approved or the one-time pickup proof expires.
connection.awaitingApprovalNext: Approval is checked automatically. Your site administrator will receive a site token separately — enter it above, then save settings.

allowlist.title: Approved query allowlist
allowlist.description: Only checked aggregate query types can be answered. Unknown commands are rejected and audited.
allowlist.resistance_rateDetail: Aggregate tested and resistant counts with the derived rate.
allowlist.isolate_countDetail: Aggregate isolate totals for approved criteria.
allowlist.organism_distributionDetail: Aggregate counts grouped by coded organism.
allowlist.specimen_distributionDetail: Aggregate counts grouped by coded specimen.
allowlist.cluster_scanDetail: Daily organism and recorded-resistant (R) phenotype counts only; no patient, specimen or ward identifiers.
allowlist.heartbeatDetail: Site availability without patient or isolate rows.

privacy.title: Privacy contract
privacy.description: Enforced locally before any response leaves this computer.
privacy.aggregateBody: No patient identifiers or row-level isolate records.
privacy.allowlistBody: Unknown commands are rejected before local execution.
privacy.criteriaBody: Server criteria are restricted to supported aggregate filters.
privacy.auditedBody: Transaction ID, query type and outcome are retained locally.
privacy.credentialsBody: OS keychain-backed safe storage; tokens are redacted from logs.

location.title: Optional location sharing
location.description: Coordinates are never collected or sent without explicit site consent.
location.consentDetail: This consent can be withdrawn at any time.
location.note: Site-level coordinates only. Never patient or specimen collection coordinates.
location.coordinatesOptional: Leave both blank to report only that this site is online. Fill both to place it on the national map.
location.detectedDetail: Latitude {{latitude}}, longitude {{longitude}} (accurate to about {{accuracy}} m). Correct either field by hand if this is not where the laboratory is.
location.denied: This computer would not share its location
location.deniedDetail: Location services are switched off, or this application has been refused them. Turn them on for this application, or type the coordinates in below — either works.
location.failedDetail: This computer could not determine where it is.
location.unavailable: No location service on this computer
location.unavailableDetail: This build has no location service available. Type the site coordinates in below.
location.notAvailableHere: Reading this computer’s location is not available here

notify.savedDetail: Secrets are stored through the operating system encryption service.
notify.tokenConfiguredDetail: The token was encrypted locally and will not be shown in full.
notify.startFailedDetail: Review the server URL, token and network status.
notify.startedDetail: Long-poll and WebSocket listeners are now supervised.
notify.stoppedDetail: Local data entry remains fully available.

help.channels: AMRIT supports two supervised channels: long-poll endpoints for queued aggregate requests, and a WebSocket for server-initiated requests. Both use the same local privacy boundary.
help.tokenBody: After Request access, the main process polls at the server-specified interval. On approval it stores the authentication token in the OS credential vault and destroys the one-time pickup proof.
help.offlineBody: Data entry, masters, analytics and export remain local and functional while federation is stopped or unreachable. Backoff avoids tight retry loops.
